content: coffee A controlled explosion on a film set near London’s O2 arena ignited a fire that destroyed a van and heavily damaged a car and lorry, prompting the London fire brigade to respond to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown just before 8 p.m. on Saturday; about twenty‑five firefighters brought the blaze under control in just over an hour with no injuries reported. The incident followed a pre‑planned filming activity at the site, which is close to the venue that will host concerts by Niall Horan and Texas next week, and the brigade later posted on X confirming the fire was contained, noting the loss of the van and substantial damage to the other vehicles while reiterating there were no casualties. They added that the fire originated from the controlled explosion that spread beyond expectations, and crews remained on scene for the rest of the evening. The yard is also situated near London’s cable car link over the River Thames, and a Metropolitan Police spokesperson said they were aware of reports of explosions heard in the area of the O2 in Greenwich.
